description:
Recognizes bird vocalizations in audio recordings.

Chirpity is your ultimate companion for identifying bird vocalisations. Designed with Nocmig enthusiasts and bioacoustic researchers in mind, Chirpity revolutionises the process of reviewing extensive audio files for the presence of avian sounds. Powered by cutting-edge Machine Learning, Chirpity offers the choice between the well-known BirdNET and a bespoke Nocmig model - finely tuned for Nocturnal Flight Calls - ensuring identification tailored to your specific needs. With intuitive features for reviewing, tagging, and organizing detected calls, Chirpity saves valuable time and effort.
What's new
- Image thumbnails now shown for bird species in the summary and enabled by default. They can be disabled in the detection settings.
- Settings use an accordion for easier navigation
- An experimental video capture allows you to record the spectrogram window for social sharing
- New spectrogram options for members: Mel and Logarithmic scale, dynamic range, pre-emphasis, and auto-gain
Bug fixes
- Spec zoom is fixed after switching between archive and analysis views
- Pagination shows the correct number of pages after changing settings
- Pass through WAV export now preserves the number of channels and sample rate when high/low pass filters are enabled
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Mattk70/Chirpity-Electron/compare/v6.0.4...v6.1.0
